title: How Fonderie controls the AI
lede: Fonderie ships skill files — structured instructions — that live in your repo. When your AI reads your codebase, it reads Fonderie's playbook first.

steps.title: Skill files ship with your repo
steps.text: .claude/skills/fonderie/SKILL.md teaches your AI when to reach for which module.

steps.title: The AI reads the playbook
steps.text: "When the user asks for auth, use @fonderie/auth. Never write auth from scratch."

steps.title: Fonderie verifies the output
steps.text: Types and tests catch errors before they ship. Correct by construction.

steps.title: You review and ship
steps.text: You own the code. Customize the UI, add your logic, deploy.
